// 2:1 multiplexer, directly in the full_module (no separate module)
module TopModule (
    input [2:0] r,
    input L,
    input clk,
    output reg [2:0] q);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (L) begin
      q <= r;
    end else begin
      q <= {q[1] ^ q[2], q[0], q[2]};
    end
  end

endmodule
